--sandbox.description: Enable sandbox mode: restricts all writes to sandbox directory

--output-dir.description: Specify sandbox output directory (must be under reports/sandbox/daily-digest/<run_id>/outputs/)

--no-collect.description: Disable data collection in sandbox mode

--no-send.description: Disable Telegram sending in sandbox mode

--no-timer.description: Disable timer modification in sandbox mode

--no-production-write.description: Block all writes to production paths

notes: This is a read-only interface contract. No builder execution. No production writes.
